questions.prompt: Tell me a bit about yourself and your background.
questions.zh: 简单介绍一下你自己和你的背景。
outline: One-line headline: role, years of experience, main domain
Current role: what you own and at what scale
One or two highlights with measurable impact
Close with what you want next and why this role

chunks.term: I'm a full-stack engineer with ... years of experience.
chunks.zh: 我是一名有……年经验的全栈工程师。

chunks.term: What I'm looking for next is ...

followUps: What made you move from your previous company to your current one?

questions.prompt: What does your current role look like? What are you responsible for day to day?
questions.zh: 你现在的岗位是什么样的？日常负责哪些事情？
outline: The team and product in one sentence, then your scope
What you own outright versus what you contribute to
How your time splits across coding, design, reviews, and mentoring
One recent piece of work that shows your level

chunks.zh: 指导初级工程师、带新人

followUps: How big is your team, and how is the work divided?

questions.prompt: What's the most technically challenging project you've worked on?
questions.zh: 你做过的技术上最有挑战的项目是什么？
outline: Context: the product, the scale, why the project mattered
Name the hard part precisely: scale, legacy, ambiguity, or deadline
Your role and the key decisions you made
Trade-offs you accepted and the measurable result
What you would do differently now
followUps: What was the hardest trade-off you had to make on that project?

questions.prompt: What accomplishment are you most proud of in your career so far?
questions.zh: 到目前为止，你职业生涯里最自豪的成就是什么？
outline: Pick one achievement with clear user or business impact
The starting point: what was broken, slow, or missing
What you personally drove, not only what the team did
Before-and-after numbers
Why this one matters to you

questions.prompt: Walk me through the tech stack of your most recent project. Why did you choose it?
questions.zh: 讲讲你最近一个项目的技术栈。当时为什么这么选？
outline: Name the stack briefly: frontend, backend, data, infrastructure
Constraints behind the choice: team skills, timeline, expected scale
Alternatives you considered and why you rejected them
What worked well and what you would change today

chunks.term: good enough for our use case
chunks.zh: 对我们的场景来说已经够用
不值得为此增加复杂度

followUps: If you were starting that project today, would you pick the same stack?

questions.prompt: Why are you looking to leave your current job?
questions.zh: 你为什么想离开现在的工作？
outline: Start positive: what you learned and valued there
Give the honest reason, framed as growth rather than complaints
What is missing now: scope, scale, or technical challenge
Connect it to what this role offers

chunks.zh: 遇到天花板、没有上升空间了
成长到原有的（岗位、方案）不够用了

chunks.term: What I'm looking for next is ...

followUps: What would have made you stay?

questions.prompt: Why do you want to work here, and why this role in particular?
questions.zh: 你为什么想来我们这里工作？为什么是这个岗位？
outline: Show you did your homework: product, engineering culture, current challenges
Match your experience to what the team needs
What you would learn here that you cannot learn now
What you expect to contribute in the first few months

chunks.term: What drew me to this role is ...
chunks.zh: 这个岗位吸引我的地方是……

questions.prompt: Where do you see yourself in three to five years?
questions.zh: 你觉得三到五年后自己会是什么样？
outline: State a direction: deeper technical track or people leadership
The scope and skills you want to grow into
How this role is a step on that path
Stay realistic and flexible; avoid naming a fixed title

chunks.zh: 指导初级工程师、带新人
没有职权也能影响别人

chunks.term: What I'm looking for next is ...

followUps: Do you see yourself moving into management or staying on the technical track?

questions.prompt: What would you say are your greatest strengths as an engineer?
questions.zh: 作为工程师，你觉得自己最大的强项是什么？
outline: Pick two strengths that matter for a senior role
Back each one with a short, concrete example
Show the effect on the team or the product
Avoid generic claims such as being hard-working

chunks.term: Let me give you a concrete example.
chunks.zh: 我给你举个具体的例子。
尽早把（风险、问题）提出来

followUps: How would your teammates describe you?

questions.prompt: What's your biggest weakness, or an area you're actively working to improve?
questions.zh: 你最大的短板是什么？或者说，你正在努力改进的是哪方面？
outline: Name a real weakness, not a strength in disguise
Give a brief example of how it showed up
What you are doing about it, concretely
Evidence that it is getting better

chunks.term: An area I'm working on is ...
chunks.zh: 我正在改进的一个方面是……
把任务放手交给别人做

questions.prompt: What kind of team and engineering culture do you do your best work in?
questions.zh: 在什么样的团队和工程文化里，你的工作状态最好？
outline: Name two or three things that matter most to you
Describe a team where you did your best work
Show you can adapt when conditions are less than ideal
Relate it to what you know about this team

chunks.zh: 保留不同意见，但全力执行决定
为（某人）创造成功的条件

chunks.term: How are technical decisions made on the team?
chunks.zh: 团队里的技术决策是怎么做出来的？

questions.prompt: You describe yourself as full-stack. Where is your real depth: frontend, backend, or somewhere in between?
questions.zh: 你说自己是全栈。你真正深入的是前端、后端，还是介于两者之间？
outline: Be honest about where you are strongest and why
Give one example of depth from each side of the stack
Explain how seeing the whole stack improves your design decisions
Say where you want to go deeper next

chunks.term: I haven't used ... in production, but ...
chunks.zh: 我没在生产环境用过……，不过……
从总体上讲、不涉及细节地说

followUps: Tell me about a problem you could only solve because you understood both sides.

questions.prompt: What's a technical decision you made in the past that you would make differently today?
questions.zh: 过去你做过的哪个技术决策，放到今天你会换一种做法？
outline: The decision and the context at the time
Why it seemed right given what you knew
What changed, or what you missed
What you would choose today and the lesson you took

chunks.zh: 考虑到当时的限制条件

chunks.term: If I were to do it again, I would ...

questions.prompt: Pick a system you know well and walk me through its architecture.
questions.zh: 挑一个你很熟悉的系统，给我讲讲它的架构。
outline: Start with what the system does and who uses it
Main components and how a request flows through them
One or two key design decisions and their trade-offs
Known weak spots and what you would improve
Check which part the interviewer wants to explore

chunks.term: Is there a particular area you'd like me to focus on?
chunks.zh: 有没有哪一块你希望我重点讲？

followUps: What would break first if traffic grew ten times?

questions.prompt: Do you have any questions for us?
questions.zh: 你有什么问题想问我们吗？
outline: Always have two or three questions ready
Ask about the team's current challenges and priorities
Ask how success is measured in the first six months
Ask how technical decisions get made
Close by asking about next steps

chunks.term: What does success look like in this role?
chunks.zh: 这个岗位怎样才算做得成功？

chunks.term: What are the biggest challenges the team is facing right now?
chunks.zh: 团队目前面临的最大挑战是什么？

chunks.term: How are technical decisions made on the team?
chunks.zh: 团队里的技术决策是怎么做出来的？

chunks.term: What does a typical day look like on your team?
chunks.zh: 你们团队典型的一天是什么样的？

chunks.term: What are the next steps in the process?
chunks.zh: 接下来的流程是怎样的？
